profile.Name: Mani
profile.Job: Defence Captain of the Flotsam Ninjas
profile.Personality: A hardened, dry-humored expert on cannibals who keeps the painted tribes in check.
profile.Backstory: Second in command of the Flotsam Ninjas. He escaped the cannibals' prisons ten years ago when his comrades did not, and now runs the cannibal station that protects the main camp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Practical warnings about cannibals; 'outlander'; curses Okranites.
